comments:
Confirmed, seems to be an accidental mistake that `state` handling only added to `RouterLinkWithHref`, but missing in `RouterLink`:

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/8b0cb2f0c503f6be25ae070b0588774285374d04/packages/router/src/directives/router_link.ts#L260-L264

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/8b0cb2f0c503f6be25ae070b0588774285374d04/packages/router/src/directives/router_link.ts#L163-L166

Note: unrelated to mat-button.

@trotyl @broweratcognitecdotcom ,
Are you planning to open a PR, or should I go ahead and open one.
Cool thanks guys will raise an PR today. @kapunahelewong can you tag it under community I will work on it.
@atscott inconvenient? The feature is downright broken.

Not sure if this comment in the CHANGELOG indicates that this was supposed to be fixed in 9.1.0:

router: state data missing in routerLink (#33203) (de67978)

But it appears to be broken again in 9.1.0. It was working fine in 9.0.7.
If I don't use routerLink in the html and navigate from the component using router.navigate instead, it works fine.

The changelog is incorrect - the commit was reverted, as noted in the PR (changelog generation doesn't understand reverted PRs and the manual correction is prone to errors). Waiting on PR author to add a test case.
